clauses.heading: Facility Classification and Exposure
clauses.text: The  Borealis  Central  Processing  Facility  and  all  associated  satellite  gathering  manifolds  (Specifically Manifold Loops A, B, and C) are designated as a  Class-3 Arctic Industrial Zone (Zone-A3) . Unlike enclosed temperate skid modules, all primary manifold assemblies, pigging receivers, and outdoor transfer headers operate continuously in exposed ambient conditions subject to wind-chill and radiative cooling.

clauses.heading: Thermal & Pressure Envelope Baseline
clauses.text: Under normal steady-state circulation, the primary process fluid is maintained between +15°C and +40°C at a  nominal  operating  pressure  of  120  PSI  (8.27  bar),  with  surge  tolerances  up  to  145  PSI.  However, meteorological records for Zone-A3 mandate a winter minimum ambient design temperature (MDMT) of -42°C (-43.6°F)  during shutdown, stagnant hold, or cold-restart events. Consequently, any piping, valve, fastener, or instrumentation component installed in Zone-A3 is strictly subject to the Cryogenic Excursion Protocol detailed in Volume II, Section 4.3.

clauses.heading: Order of Precedence for Conflicting Specifications
clauses.text: Contractors  and  automated  quoting  systems  must  resolve  material  conflicts  using  a  strict  three-tier precedence  model.  In  the  event  of  conflicting  part  numbers,  material  grades,  or  pressure-temperature ratings: Tier 1 (Baseline): Section 2.0 Baseline Piping & Valve Schedules apply only to standard non- excursion service. Tier 2 (Environmental & Chemical Overrides): Volume II, Section 4.0 Environmental and Chemical Excursion Protocols strictly SUPERSEDE all Tier 1 Baseline Schedules whenever their triggering thresholds are met. Tier 3 (Active Safety Interlocks): Volume II, Section 5.0 Mechanical & Actuator Safety Interlocks SUPERSEDE both Tier 1 and Tier 2 specifications.

clauses.heading: Baseline Mainline & Header Piping
clauses.text: For pressurized fluid transfer headers operating between 100 PSI and 150 PSI, standard High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE) PE-4710 SDR-11 piping (Part #PIPE-HDPE11-STD) with butt-fusion joints is approved as the default baseline material. • • •

clauses.heading: Baseline Manifold Isolation Valves & Elastomer Seals
clauses.text: Standard manifold isolation and block valves across Loops A, B, and C shall utilize 316 Stainless Steel floating ball valves, Part # VLV-200-SS, factory-fitted with standard fluorocarbon Viton (FKM-A) O-ring stem and seat seals (Part # SEAL-VT-09), paired with standard pneumatic rack-and-pinion actuator Part # ACT- PN-100. clauses.heading: Baseline Flange Fasteners & Bolting
clauses.text: All flanged metallic-to-polymer transition spools and valve bodies shall be assembled using  ASTM A193 Grade B7 chromium-molybdenum alloy steel stud bolts paired with ASTM A194 Grade 2H  heavy hex nuts (Kit #BOLT-B7-2H), unless overridden by low-temperature brittle-fracture schedules (see Section 4.2).

clauses.heading: Primary Heat-Transfer Stream
clauses.text: The primary heat-transfer medium circulating through Manifold Loops A and B consists of a 60/40 inhibited propylene glycol/water mixture containing up to 1.5% entrained light hydrocarbon condensate.

clauses.heading: Automated Anti-Hydrate Methanol Injection (Manifold Loop B)
clauses.text: To prevent gas-hydrate plugging during winter operations, whenever ambient temperatures fall below -15°C, Automated Chemical Dosing Skid #DS-04 continuously injects  anhydrous methanol (MeOH)  at 8.0% volume concentration directly into  Manifold Loop B  upstream of the primary isolation valves. Manifold Loops A and C do not receive methanol injection.

clauses.heading: Polar-Solvent Service Mandate
clauses.text: Any piping segment, valve chamber, or elastomer seal exposed to anhydrous methanol injection (as defined in Section 3.2) is formally classified as a Polar-Solvent Service Line. All components in a Polar-Solvent Service Line must comply with the chemical compatibility overrides in Volume II, Section 4.5.

clauses.heading: Thermal Derating & Replacement of Polymer Piping
clauses.text: Although baseline PE-4710 SDR-11 piping (Part #PIPE-HDPE11-STD, Section 2.1) is nominally rated to -40°C under static zero-pressure conditions, dynamic pressurized service (>100 PSI) in Zone-A3 environments (ambient below -35°C) combined with trace hydrocarbon condensate PROHIBITS the use of standard PE-4710 SDR-11 due to rapid crack propagation (RCP) failure risk. All such lines MUST upgrade to Cross-Linked Polyethylene PEX-a SDR-9 Arctic Grade (Part #PIPE-PEX9-ARC) or seamless carbon steel ASTM A333 Grade 6.

clauses.heading: Low-Temperature Flange Bolting Override
clauses.text: Baseline ASTM A193 Grade B7 stud bolts (Kit #BOLT-B7-2H, Section 2.3) exhibit rapid Charpy V-notch impact degradation below -29°C. Any flange assembly subject to the Cryogenic Excursion Protocol (Section 4.3) PROHIBITS Grade B7 fasteners and MUST upgrade to Charpy impact-tested ASTM A320 Grade L7 alloy steel stud bolts paired with ASTM A194 Grade 4/L4 heavy hex nuts (Kit #BOLT-L7-L4).

clauses.heading: Cryogenic Excursion Protocol Trigger
clauses.text: The Cryogenic Excursion Protocol is automatically triggered for any outdoor assembly located in a zone where the minimum design ambient temperature (MDMT) is below -30°C (including Zone-A3 at -42°C per Section 1.2). Activation of Section 4.3 mandates: (a) Low-temperature bolting per Section 4.2, (b) Thermal piping upgrade per Section 4.1, and (c) Immediate PROHIBITION of baseline Viton FKM-A elastomer seals (Part #SEAL-VT-09, Section 2.2) due to glass-transition embrittlement and seal fracture below -26°C.

clauses.heading: Low-Temperature Elastomer Seal Substitution
clauses.text: Whenever baseline Viton seals (Part #SEAL-VT-09) are prohibited by Section 4.3, engineers shall substitute Low-Temperature Fluorosilicone (FVMQ, Part #SEAL-FVMQ-40) inside standard valve body #VLV-200-SS, UNLESS the flow path is classified as a Polar-Solvent Service Line under Section 3.3.

clauses.heading: Polar-Solvent & Dual-Excursion Seal Override
clauses.text:
Fluorosilicone (FVMQ, Part #SEAL-FVMQ-40) and standard EPDM elastomers experience severe volumetric swell (>45%) and extrusion failure when exposed to anhydrous methanol + trace hydrocarbon mixtures (Section 3.2 / Section 3.3). Therefore, for any flow path subject to BOTH Cryogenic Excursion (Section 4.3) AND Polar-Solvent Service (Section 3.3), Part #SEAL-FVMQ-40 is PROHIBITED. The ONLY approved elastomer is Ultra-Low-Temperature Perfluoroelastomer FFKM (Part #SEAL-FFKM-ULT90). Furthermore, due to the wider gland geometry of #SEAL-FFKM-ULT90, baseline valve body #VLV-200-SS cannot be used; the assembly MUST upgrade to the Cryogenic Trunnion Ball Valve Body (Part #VLV-200-LT).

clauses.heading: Stem Breakaway Torque Multiplier for Ultra-Low-Temp FFKM
clauses.text: Empirical cold-box testing confirms that installing Perfluoroelastomer seal Part #SEAL-FFKM-ULT90 inside Cryogenic Trunnion Valve #VLV-200-LT increases valve stem breakaway torque by 185% at -40°C (reaching 215 Nm) compared to baseline Viton seats.

clauses.heading: Mandatory Hydraulic Actuator Substitution Directive
clauses.text: Baseline pneumatic rack-and-pinion actuator Part #ACT-PN-100 (Section 2.2) has a maximum output torque of 120 Nm and WILL STALL under emergency shutdown (ESD) demand when paired with #SEAL-FFKM-ULT90 below -30°C. Consequently, whenever Valve #VLV-200-LT is fitted with Seal #SEAL-FFKM-ULT90, Part #ACT-PN-100 is PROHIBITED and the assembly MUST upgrade to High-Torque Spring-Return Hydraulic Actuator Part #ACT-HYD-350 (rated to 400 Nm at -50°C).
